sections.content: Use después de + infinitive to say that one action happened after another. With the pretérito perfecto, the completed action is linked to the sequence. The infinitive after después de stays in its infinitive form.

items.spanish: He probado la salsa después de cocinar.
items.english: I have tasted the sauce after cooking.

items.spanish: Hemos preparado el plato después de mezclar los ingredientes.
items.english: We have prepared the dish after mixing the ingredients.

items.spanish: Carlos ha servido la comida después de cocinar.
items.english: Carlos has served the food after cooking.

items.spanish: Han probado el arroz después de preparar la receta.
items.english: They have tasted the rice after preparing the recipe.

sections.content: The verb after antes de and después de stays in the infinitive: antes de cocinar, después de cocinar.
